Parish Notices
Sunday 8th November: November Prayer: “Lord God, whose days are without end and whose mercies are beyond counting, keep us mindful that life is short and the hou r of death unknown.
Let your Spirit guide our days here on earth in ways of holiness and justice; that we may serve you in union with the whole church, sure in faith, strong in hope and perfect in love.
And when our earthly dwelling is ended, lead us rejoicing into your kingdom where you live for ever and ever.
Amen. November Lists of the dead: Please leave in your November lists of the dead in the baskets i n front of the Altar in all 3 Churches.
There will be special Masses each week for the people on those lists.

It is important during the month of November to remember our loved ones who have gone before There will be a special Mass for all those who died during the past year , from this parish, in St Clare’s Church, at 8pm on Friday November 27th.
Confessions for November: There will be an opportunity to celebrate the Sacrament of Confessions , for November, after the 10am Mass on

Monday 9th November in St Clare’s. Pope Leo’s intention for November: Let us pray for the proper use of wealth: that not succumbing to the temptation of selfishness, it may always be put at the service of the common good and solidarity of those who have less.
Manorhamilton One Acts Drama Festival that takes place annually in the Glens Centre.
It will take place over 3 nights between the 13th to the 15th of November.

The plays begin at 8pm, with doors opening at 7.30. A nightly ticket costs €15 and a season ticket costs €35. ABIDE Women's Conference 2026 | 20 –22 November: Join hundreds of women at the Great Northern Hotel, Bundoran, Co. Donegal , in just a few weeks for our third Abide Women's Conference!

Speakers inclu de Sarah Swafford, Danielle Noonan, Kimberlee Woo Ling, Fr Oisín Martin CFR, Fr Barry Braum, the Nashville Dominican Sisters, Fr David Nugent and Fr Mark Wharton, with Holy Mass celebrated by Bishop Fintan Gavin.
A beautiful weekend of faith, celebration, healing and joy!
